connector.name: Ziptax Sales Tax API
connector.registryDescription: Real-time US and Canadian sales and use tax rates by address or geo coordinates.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.zip-tax.com over server sent events. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace tax.zip. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-KEY
headers.description: Your Ziptax API key. Get a free key at https://platform.zip.tax
